Bash(gh pr create --title "feat\(P2\): multi-team extensions and UX improvements" --body "$\(cat <<''EOF''
## Summary

- Add multi-team support with team selection and vocabulary management
- Implement general meeting type with AI-generated titles
- Add meeting location field throughout the stack
- Fix Confluence nested list indentation rendering
- Enable inline title editing on minutes page
- Apply UI/UX improvements with better date picker and form layouts
- Add meeting edit/delete functionality to dashboard
- Support new Confluence task-list expand format in weekly report parser

## Changes

### Backend \(API\)
- Add `location` field to meetings model and schema
- Fix Confluence markdown indentation \(2-space → 4-space normalization\)
- Support AI-suggested titles for general meetings
- Add vocabulary pipeline for team-specific terminology
- Parse new Confluence task-list expand format

### Frontend \(Web\)
- Add DatePicker component with Korean locale
- Add location input to meeting creation form
- Enable inline meeting title editing on minutes page
- Add meeting edit/delete actions on dashboard
- Improve UI/UX with shadcn/ui components
- Replace Weeky emoji with PNG assets

### Infrastructure
- Add Alembic migration for location column
- Update OpenAPI schema and generated types

## Test plan

- [ ] Create a new meeting with custom date, title, and location
- [ ] Verify location appears in generated minutes
- [ ] Edit meeting title from minutes page
- [ ] Publish to Confluence and verify nested lists render correctly
- [ ] Create general meeting and verify AI generates meaningful title
- [ ] Edit/delete meetings from dashboard

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code]\(https://claude.com/claude-code\)
EOF
\)")
